svg.aria-label: What each of four ranks holds before and after the main NCCL collectives, with the JAX call each lowers to. AllReduce, psum in JAX, leaves the full sum on every rank. Broadcast copies the root rank's data to all ranks. Reduce leaves the sum only on the root. AllGather, all_gather, gives every rank all four blocks in order. ReduceScatter, psum_scatter, leaves rank i with the sum of block i. AllToAll, all_to_all, sends chunk j of every rank to rank j. In a ring all-reduce each rank sends a chunk to the next rank, and after 2(n−1) steps every rank holds the sum. With two V100s n is 2, so each sends half its data twice, and psum is how the two GPUs add their u_sum and w_sum.
